items.title: 2.7 Momentum (mass aur velocity ka product) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.7 with Fig. 2.9, Examples 2.6 and 2.7 and the boxes (PDF 38-41, printed 35-38).

blocks.text: Hum jaante hain ke chalti hui cheez mein ek aisi quality (khoobi) hoti hai jis ki wajah se woh har us cheez par force lagati hai jo use rokne ki koshish kare. Cheez jitni tez chal rahi ho, use rokna utna mushkil. Isi tarah agar do cheezen ek hi velocity se chal rahi hon to zyada mass wali (bhaari) ko rokna zyada mushkil hai. Newton ne is quality ko "quantity of motion" kaha. Ab ise linear momentum p⃗ kehte hain, aur is ki definition yeh hai:

Yahan v mass m ki velocity hai. Is liye linear momentum vector quantity hai aur us ki direction wahi hai jo velocity ki. Momentum ka SI unit kilogram metre per second (kg m s⁻¹) hai; ise newton second (N s) bhi likh sakte hain.
